import re
from wordcloud import WordCloud
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def task_func(text):
    if text is None:
        text = ""
    elif not isinstance(text, str):
        text = str(text)

    url_pattern = re.compile(
        r"""
        \b(?:
            https?://[^\s]+ |
            www\.[^\s]+
        )
        """,
        re.IGNORECASE | re.VERBOSE,
    )

    cleaned_text = url_pattern.sub(" ", text)

    if not re.search(r"\b\w+\b", cleaned_text):
        raise ValueError("No words available to generate a word cloud after removing URLs.")

    wordcloud = WordCloud().generate(cleaned_text)

    plt.figure(figsize=(10, 5))
    plt.imshow(wordcloud, interpolation="bilinear")
    plt.axis("off")
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

    return wordcloud

import re
from wordcloud import WordCloud
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def task_func(text):
    text = "" if text is None else str(text)

    url_pattern = re.compile(r"(?:https?://\S+|www\.\S+)", re.IGNORECASE)
    cleaned_text = url_pattern.sub(" ", text).strip()

    if not re.search(r"\b[a-zA-Z]+\b", cleaned_text):
        raise ValueError("No words available to generate a word cloud after removing URLs.")

    wordcloud = WordCloud().generate(cleaned_text)

    plt.figure(figsize=(10, 5))
    plt.imshow(wordcloud, interpolation="bilinear")
    plt.axis("off")
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()

    return wordcloud
